# Interfloor

> > Leading manufacturer and supplier of carpet underlays, flooring accessories, and installation products for residential and commercial applications.

Interfloor specializes in premium underlay brands including Tredaire, Duralay, and Durafit, offering innovative solutions with technologies like Stretch Fit for sound insulation, heat insulation, and flooring performance. The company serves both professional installers and specifiers across residential and commercial markets with products ranging from PU foam and sponge underlays to LVT systems and installation accessories.

## Key Topics

- Carpet underlay and flooring underlay systems
- Tredaire brand - PU foam and sponge underlays
- Duralay brand - professional-grade underlay solutions
- Stretch Fit technology for easy installation
- Sound insulation and acoustic performance
- Heat insulation and thermal efficiency (TOG ratings)
- Commercial and contract flooring applications
- LVT (Luxury Vinyl Tile) underlay systems
- Durafit System for commercial installations
- PU foam and sponge underlay materials
- Crumb rubber underlay products
- Installation accessories (adhesives, gripper rods)
- LEED and BREEAM sustainability certifications
- Underfloor heating compatibility
- Flame retardant underlay solutions

## Product Catalog - Carpet Underlays

- [Duralay Heatflow Wood & Laminate Underlay](https://www.interfloor.com/underlay/duralay-heatflow-wood-laminate): Duralay Heatflow underlay for wood/laminate with underfloor heating

- [Brio](https://www.interfloor.com/de/unterlage/brio): Brio PU foam underlay by Tredaire with sound/heat insulation
- [Dynamics](https://www.interfloor.com/de/unterlage/dynamics): Dynamics sponge underlay by Tredaire with Stretch Fit
- [Royale 600](https://www.interfloor.com/underlay/royale-600): Royale 600 sponge underlay with Stretch Fit technology
- [Treadmore](https://www.interfloor.com/de/unterlage/treadmore): Treadmore crumb material underlay by Tredaire with Stretch Fit
- [System Ten International](https://www.interfloor.com/fr/sous-couche/system-ten): System Ten crumb underlay for carpet and natural flooring
- [LVT Multi-Fit Underlay](https://www.interfloor.com/underlay/lvt-multi-fit-underlay): Duralay LVT Multi-Fit underlay for luxury vinyl tile flooring
